_routing_note: Roster sheet URL + admin endpoint live on truesight.me/programs/ivy-yoga/manifest.json. Fetch that manifest at runtime to discover roster_sheet_url and tokenomics_admin_endpoint.

cert_template._note: Real v1.2 design (Shahbaz, 2026-08-17), hand-delivered by Gary 2026-08-18. cert_config.json overlay coordinates + font identification reverse-engineered via PDF text/image extraction — see cert_template/README.md. signature_bilal/signature_olivia/certificate_id overlay fields are documented but not yet wired into lineage-engine's renderer (PR3, gated).

_trust_source_note: Trust circle = whoever is an editor on the roster sheet. Both the admin panel (auth gate) and the central tokenomics handler (signature verification) resolve via the central tokenomics GAS endpoint's list_sheet_editors&sheet_url=... action. No per-program GAS proxy deployment; no static authorized_attestors[] list.
